title: One cumulative BUILD_ONLY release attempt with deterministic derived StageB binding
explicit_change: Replace current requirement that final release-header bytes are frozen before every slot with a top-level immutable derivation recipe plus one-time derived StageB evidence frozen after successful StageA. Existing BuildOnly._inputs/_check and original frozen-header contract do not implement or authorize this.
immutable_before_first_effect: One original owner PID/creation identity, one logical assignment, one physical ledger handle/identity and original absolute deadline
Exact source closure, derivation function bytes, interpreter, SDK/compiler/linker/dependency custody, four fixed launch slots and argv/environment; no cmd/vcvars or arbitrary callbacks
Exact StageA watchdog source/compile/link inputs and fixed watchdog target path; exact StageB guardian source/input/output paths including future header path

Exact canonical header derivation schema: release_header on fixed interpreter/program pins and watchdog target path with independently observed StageA DLL SHA256; fixed header path and single-create semantics
Exact derived StageB manifest schema with top-level recipe/assignment hash, StageA outcome/binary identity/hash, derived header bytes/hash and prior physical-ledger tip binding
One unchanged cumulative limit set, failure policy, artifact/output/storage inventory and explicit external settlement scopes

stages.name: A
rules: Precharge each supervised attempted OS launch to same physical ledger before CreateProcess effects, including failed/rejected creation
Assign same retained root Job at suspended process creation; validate exact image, PID/creation identity, membership and caps before resume
Observe signaled retained process births, complete output/EOF and normal all-helper closure after each stage; no residual process may retain or mutate watchdog bytes
Do not import, LoadLibrary, invoke or run produced watchdog DLL

stages.name: DERIVE_ONCE
rules: Requires successful StageA with no previous failure and original owner/ledger/deadline intact; no new process lifetime or budget
Retain exact StageA DLL read custody denying replacement/write, hash actual bytes; source-to-image and complete dependency qualification remain separate
Generate header by pinned deterministic rule into prospectively fixed absent path; partial write or existing file is terminal; freeze byte hash and retained input custody
Create derived StageB manifest once at fixed absent path and append its exact byte hash, header hash and StageA observation binding to same ledger before either StageB precharge
Derivation performs no new launch and grants no independent authority; any caller-supplied replacement derivation values rejected; costs charged to declared original-owner/external scope

stages.name: B
rules: Same original producer/assignment/physical ledger/root Job/deadline and cumulative counters; no reopen/restore/reconstruction constructor
Validate top-level recipe plus exact derived manifest/header/binary custody before StageB and again after effects
Precharge third and fourth exact slots only; no rerun of StageA or slot replacement; no generated guardian execution

cumulative_limits.scope: Existing BUILD_ONLY values unchanged, cumulatively across A, derivation, B and closure; active count is simultaneous cap, never cumulative attempted births
cumulative_limits.wall: One absolute deadline measured from original attempt claim; header/hash/observer delays consume same original wall window; no per-stage30seconds
cumulative_limits.CPU: One fresh root Job at initial zero; no resetting Job time limits/epoch or adding nested samples; root USER+KERNEL final debit once after complete termination/closure, before closing retained root handle. Existing USER30second threshold unchanged, no strict overshoot guarantee
cumulative_limits.output: Aggregate bytes across all four slots; per-slot capture is not four independent allowances
cumulative_limits.memory: Same root peak across all stages, no stage-specific cap reset
cumulative_limits.storage: Aggregate all stages, intermediates, manifests, ledger, payload, ZIP, restored copies and covered tails under existing declared scope; no separate stage allowances

fail_closed: Any failed/rejected creation, nonzero compiler/link exit, interrupted custody, missing/partial evidence or wrong event order terminal with first failure and consumed reservations retained
Any source/header/image/manifest/ledger identity change, expired original deadline or cap overrun terminal; no retries, refunds, assignment renewal, resume or deadline extension
Terminate owned root tree on failure and retain process handles through signaled birth verification and final root counters; failed termination/missing counters remain unresolved debt, not zero
Derivation or archive failure preserves StageA bytes, partial header/output and all costs without StageB authority
external_costs: Owner/header derivation/hash/observer/archive/restoration/cleanup/completion/final-writer and registry costs need disjoint explicit scopes. Root final CPU does not include external owner CPU or every system/service cost; missing costs remain debt. Current settlement always leaves final live writer tail unresolved and cannot assert complete finite closure.
